How Spend & Win Retreats Work

Shoppers Spend To Win A Retreat That Pays For Itself

Customers spend to qualify, one wins a FLYCO retreat, and the retail lift covers the trip. Sheng Siong has run spend and win for years to lift basket size, because a high perceived value prize pushes shoppers past their usual threshold. A retreat is the strongest prize you can put in front of them.

  • We design the spend trigger, entry route and retreat prize framing
  • In-store display, QR entry and campaign artwork produced by us
  • Retail revenue tracked against the cost of the retreat, so the return is measurable
  • The prize is a retreat you own, not a voucher that erases your branding

Your Content Output, Multiplied

Four Days Of Shooting. A Quarter Of Creative.

Meta rewards variety, and punishes repetition. Your cost per result follows.

One creator in one room means creative fatigue, rising cost per result, and a campaign that stalls two weeks in.

Every leg of the retreat is a different setting and a different angle, so your media buyer always has fresh creative to rotate. One production window instead of six separate shoots. One retreat, and a library that feeds paid, organic and retail for months.

For the brand team
Where your logo actually lives On a gift card, redeemed at someone else's checkout, then thrown away. On the welcome kit, the flags, the court, the studio and every frame filmed across four days.
What the customer feels They saved money. The feeling fades by the next promotion. They were chosen and flown somewhere by your brand. People tell that story for years.
What it does to your pricing Discounting teaches the market to wait for the next offer before buying. A retreat is a reward for spending more, so the ticket goes up and full price holds.
How easily a rival copies it A competitor can match your discount by Friday, then beat it. A named retreat, an owned format and licensed footage nobody else has.
For the marketing team
What you own the Monday after A redemption report and a folder of stock lifestyle images. A brand highlight film, 6 cutdowns and 3 UGC testimonials, delivered production ready.
Creative rotation for paid spend One key visual. Fatigue and rising cost per result within two weeks. Five backdrops in four days, so your media buyer always has fresh creative to rotate.
How the creator content reads Paid posts filmed at home between other jobs. The disclosure caps the trust. Creators living with the product for four days against a shot list built for your category.
What happens after the campaign It stops the day the voucher window closes. Reach ends when spend ends. Guests and creators keep posting for months. Earned reach continues after the invoice is closed.
For the finance team
Where the cost lands Straight off gross margin, on every discounted unit sold. One marketing line item. Customers spend more to qualify instead of paying less to buy.
Budget certainty Open liability. Redemption above forecast blows the line item. A fixed quote from SGD 20,000, scoped and capped before any deposit is paid.
Suppliers and accountability Agency, production house, media buyer and fulfilment. Four invoices, four points of blame. One licensed operator, one invoice. Travel Licence No. TA03759 covers flights, hotels and ground logistics.
Evidence you can take to the board A redemption rate, which only tells you who wanted the discount. Holistic Way: 170+ tracked purchases, $32,000+ retail revenue, 11x return in a three day window.

Before You Enquire

The Questions Brands Ask First

How far ahead do we need to plan?

Eight to ten weeks is comfortable for an Asia retreat and gives us room to secure the right creators and rates. We have turned trips around faster, but flight and hotel costs rise sharply inside six weeks and creator availability narrows.

Do we need to bring our own influencers?

No. We source, negotiate and manage the creators, and you approve the shortlist before anything is confirmed. If you already work with talent you like, we bring them into the trip instead.

Who owns the content afterwards?

You receive usage rights for one month on the Asia packages and three months on the international package. Extended or perpetual rights can be quoted upfront. Creator posts stay on creator accounts under the terms agreed in their contract.

How do the customers get selected?

Usually through the spend and win mechanic, which is what makes the campaign pay for itself. It can also run as a loyalty reward, a top customer invite or a competition on your own channels. We design the mechanic with you.

What if our budget is under SGD 20,000?

Say so in the form. We run local influencer campaigns and content production without the travel component, and those start well below the retreat packages. We would rather scope something that works than push you into a trip.

Can we send our own team instead of customers?

Yes. Some brands use the same structure for a staff or partner retreat with content production attached. The logistics and crew are identical, only the mechanic changes.

Is FLYCO a licensed travel operator?

Yes. Retreats are operated by Flyco Business Pte. Ltd. together with I Quadrant Travel Pte. Ltd. under Travel Licence No. TA03759.
